new_ops.reason: Causal softmax attention whose logits add Transformer-XL relative-position terms: per-head query against projected sinusoidal relative-distance embeddings plus learned global content/position bias vectors, computed with a relative shift over [heads, T, T]; relative distances clamped at 2048 at evaluation. output.notes: Described the headline Gopher 280B; all six family sizes from Table 1 listed. The paper inherits from GPT-2 except for RMSNorm and Transformer-XL relative positions. Pre-norm, GELU (tanh), residuals, tied embeddings, no MoE and full MHA (kv heads = heads) are marked inherited from GPT-2. d_ff is computed from the stated rule 'always 4 x d_model'; the numeric value itself does not appear in the source. The fine-tuning appendix says bias-only tuning had to 'Introduce attention biases', which suggests the attention projections have no bias, against GPT-2. Because of that conflict, qkv/mlp bias are left not_stated. Norm eps is not stated.
